body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SPH-V9900'' 6.9mm rose-pink-color ultra edition during KES 2006. This CDMA 2000 1x EV-DO(1900MHz) mobile phone features 2M camera, 1.9-inch QVGA display, VOD/MOD/MP3 playback, an electronic dictionary, mp3 BGM, a file viewer, ''playing with my pet'' feature and etc.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
